entry mysteriously vanished from the Applications pulldown in my upper

If there's any sort of log analysis or diagnostic that could help pin

Re: Building binutils/gcc/glibc -
quotation
That thread hardly seems to justify not using the existing POSIXLY_CORRECT
variable to control this. Indeed the situation of rejecting "head -1"
seems perfectly to fit the description in
http://mail.gnu.org/archive/html/bug-coreutils/2003-09/msg00094.html
-
"people are welcome to enable POSIXLY_CORRECT, but few should want to,
because doing so disables useful behavior" - "head -1" is the useful
behavior in question and few want to disable it. Indeed I cannot see a
requirement in POSIX at all to reject "head -1" (unlike cases where
obsolescent usage used + to introduce options, which must be treated as

Re: All you wanted to know about the FSL MCU roadmap but were too afraid to ask
The BDM was a extremely well thought out interface, the first of its kind
and certanly something to capitalize on for this market. This allows cheap
affordable debugging features and there are already a considirable amount of
tool support for the HCS12 series.

Freescale did indeed improve very much by providing easy and quick access to
samples and with its listing in the DigiKey cataloge - thanks very much.

However it is the responsibility of Freescale to not send mixed signals - we
users have a VERY sensitive ear for companies with inconsistant business
